remarks: Great opportunity in the heart of Westport! Enjoy this sun-drenched contemporary split-level home with an open, versatile floor plan. This beautiful home is located in a highly sought-after neighborhood, near the conveniences of Westport yet situated on a private, peaceful property. Enjoy a fenced-in backyard with an expansive bi-level deck for entertaining.    As you enter this home you will immediately notice the abundant natural light and vaulted ceilings. The living room features a fireplace and built-ins. It opens to the kitchen with breakfast bar and dining area with skylight. The walk-out lower level is fully finished and includes a family room with wet bar/kitchenette, Den/BR, full bath and laundry room. Lots of possiblities for a home office, in-law suite, au pair suite or guest quarters. The primary bedroom with en-suite bathroom is located on the upper level and features a screened in porch with French doors - perfect for enjoying your morning coffee! The second level also includes 2 generous sized bedrooms, full bath, storage and linen closets.    This property is ideally located close to the train station, beaches, downtown area and all Westport amenities. This property has so much potential - don't miss your chance to make this home your own! This home is listed in "as is" condition.
